tuning_key.text: I don't know where we're going and I don't know where we've been
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The weight of pretending to know where this ends is heavier than the unknown itself. Today, trust is not a belief you perform but a pulse you expose—steady, unadorned, willing to hold the static between where you have been and where you are going. You do not need to silence the noise to move; you only need to agree that this honest beat is ground enough. Step forward not because the path is clear, but because the willingness to not know is the only real traction any of us have right now.

practice.title: Locate the Brace
practice.instruction: Scan your body for where you are holding tension against the unknown, and let that resistance become heavy enough to feel without fixing it.

practice.title: Release the Map
practice.instruction: Exhale completely and allow your hands, jaw, or shoulders to drop the grip of needing to predict what arrives next.

practice.title: Expose the Pulse
practice.instruction: Speak aloud the words "I am done pretending I can read what has not yet arrived," letting your voice find the steady, unadorned rhythm that holds the static without silencing it.
